description: What the NY OMIG Medicaid exclusion data covers and how current it is: total exclusions held, how many carry an NPI or license number, how many distinct provider types appear, the oldest and newest exclusion dates, and OMIG's own "data last updated" date for the copy this pack serves. Use to check the screening data is fresh enough to rely on before a compliance decision, and to see the one-line note on what OMIG does NOT publish (exclusion reason/authority). Pass year (e.g. 2025) or start_date/end_date to instead COUNT how many exclusions have an effective date in that year or range, counted over the whole ~9,100-row list, not a page — answers "how many NY OMIG exclusions took effect in 2025". The response names the date field counted (excluded_since, OMIG's exclusion effective date). Sourced from NY OMIG, keyless.
name: ny_omig_exclusion_coverage
